method: All 24 draft assets were copied into a private server stage and pinned by full size/SHA-256 to the frozen build audit. The publication gate fully verified all 22 indexed lane files by size/SHA-256/SHA-512, then moved only the new version downloads to their immutable directory and atomically switched release-current. The real public API matched the frozen index-derived metadata; 40 historical installer inodes, sizes, mtimes and first/last samples were unchanged. Public HTTPS HEAD/Range/feed checks and native updates are separate records.
